ModMetaData.name: RimFeast
ModMetaData.author: BenFD
ModMetaData.description:
RimFeast lets you host medieval banquets. Place a feast spot in your great hall and send a messenger to a noble house. A cortege rides in under their banner, sits at your tables, eats your food and drinks your mead, and your colonists drop what they are doing to join them.
The evening is judged on what you actually served: the beauty of the hall, the quality of the dishes, whether there was enough of the good stuff to go round, the drink, the toasts and the music. A good feast raises goodwill, sends merchants your way, and now and then a noble asks for a colonist's hand. A poor one travels just as far. Invite a house that hates you and someone will try to salt your table.
There is a second invitation button. Same messenger, same gifts, different plan. Once the guests are seated you pick who dies first, and your hall becomes a killing floor. Break the guest right and every house on the rim hears about it.
Houses invite you back too. Take a caravan to their gates and find out whether they set a table or a trap. Who you send decides how the evening goes.
No required dependencies. Medieval Overhaul is optional but recommended: with it the houses arrive in full livery, standard bearers and local lords and all.
